title: Mystic Pulse
description: This datapack adds drums to the game and when you play them in a specific pattern it can give you effects
body:
# **Mystic Pulse**

_This datapack adds drums to the game and when you play them in a specific pattern it can give you effects_

# **TRANSLATIONS:**

- **en_us** - American English
- **es_mx** - Español Mexicano
- **es_es** - Español de España


# **How to use your drum**

### **How do I set my drum?**

A: With right click you can put your drum

### **How can I play my drum?**

A: With Right click you can play your drum

### **How can I break my drum?**

A: With Left Click you can play your drum

# **Sequences:**

## **ABCD** - Health Boost 
**Minutes:** 2

**Level:** 4

## **ABDC** - Lightning Bolt
**RANK:** 15 Blocks

## **ACBD** - Strength
**Minutes:** 1.5

**Level:** 2

## **ACDB** - Jump Boost and Speed
Jump Bost:
**Minutes:** 1.5
**Level:** 2

Speed:
**Minutes:** 1.5
**Level:** 1

## **ADBC** - Invisibility and Night Vision
Invisibility:
**Minutes:** 1.5
**Level:** 1

Night Vision:
**Minutes:** 1.5
**Level:** 1

## **ADCB** - Fire resistance and Slow_falling
Fire Resistance:
**Minutes:** 2
**Level:** 1

Slow Falling:
**Minutes:** 2
**Level:** 1

## **BACD** - Haste and Night Vision

**Minutes:** 1.5
**Level:** 1

invisibility:

**Level:** 1

**Level:** 1

## **BCAD** - absorption and resistance
absorption:
